subject: Member form validation problem
text:
Hi,

The member form is not accepting the new registration number. When a user enters 20250147, the page shows an error saying the field format is incorrect, even though older numbers with seven digits were accepted without issue.

I tested it on two browsers, and the problem appears after clicking Submit. The form does not show a validation hint, so people may try several times and eventually give up. It began after last night’s update.

This is a small technical issue, but it could delay this week’s workshop confirmations. A few neighbors already tried to register after the meeting, and I do not want them to think the event is closed.

Can you or the form owner check whether the validation rule was changed to require an eighth digit? If that was intentional, please add a note beside the field. If not, reverting the rule or allowing both formats would fix it.

Thanks,
